fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) analyst fair value was raised from US$328.09 to US$339.04, with bullish analysts citing product momentum and cash generation, while bearish analysts point to margin pressure and iPhone demand risks.
fields.summary_ko.1: Multiple investment banks including Bernstein, Argus, and Evercore ISI raised AAPL price targets to the US$360–US$400 range, while DZ Bank and Loop Capital maintained lower targets in the US$280–US$300 range.
